titles.title: Journal of the Seal Prince's Rebellion

description:
On what seemed like just another ordinary day taking care of a baby seal, the seal suddenly transforms into a strikingly handsome young man!

His true identity is Hae-gyeol, the youngest prince of the Ocean Kingdom.

Yeo-han is already dying of stress balancing his corporate job with helping Hae-gyeol—who is on day one of being human—adjust to the world... but now he learns that if Hae-gyeol doesn't find his true love, Yeo-han himself will die?!

Will Yeo-han manage to survive this twisted twist of fate?

Find out in this chaotic romance full of Yeo-han’s survival struggles and Hae-gyeol’s quest for love! *(Source: Bomtoon, translated)*
